description: Audits a live website URL or domain for AI crawler access (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot), 25,000-token HTML RAG truncation, /llms.txt presence, Schema.org JSON-LD entities, and Google Lighthouse 13.5 /.well-known/ai-catalog.json compliance. Returns a structured Markdown diagnostic report containing a 0-100 AI Readiness Score, letter grade, raw-vs-clean token counts, per-check pass/fail status, and remediation links. Use this tool first when diagnosing why a live website is omitted by ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude; do not use it to extract full-page Markdown text (use extract_byte0_markdown instead), to synthesize manifest previews (use generate_ai_manifests instead), or to inspect local disk files (use audit_local_codebase instead). Bare domains automatically resolve to https://<domain>/, and deep URLs audit the exact page weight while checking /robots.txt and /.well-known/ai-catalog.json at the origin root. Read-only HTTP check; requires no API key, allows up to 60 requests/min, and returns a timeout message if the origin fails to respond within 8 seconds.

url.description: Fully qualified HTTPS URL or bare domain name to audit (e.g., "https://stripe.com/pricing" or "example.com"). Defaults to HTTPS if scheme is omitted.

name: audit_ai_readiness
